## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs`)
- [ ] Code style / CSS formatting (`style`)
- [ ] Refactoring (`refactor`)
- [ ] Performance improvement (`perf`)

## Invariance & Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the **Zero-Server & Zero-Install** philosophy (no Node/build tools required).
- [ ] My code introduces zero remote telemetry, cookies, or external analytics trackers.
- [ ] I have tested this change locally using the `file:///` protocol in a clean browser profile.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `URS.md`, `TASK_LIST.md`, or `README.md` if applicable.

## Screenshots / Screen Recording (if UI changes are included)
Please attach before/after screenshots or GIFs demonstrating the changes.
